source: 684 Two Answers
target: 684 Duae Responsiones

source: Observing Louis Berry’s peculiar sacrificial dance drawing to a close, Robert wasted no time.
target: Spectans saltationem sacrificii peculiarem Ludovii Berry ad finem tendentem, Robertus nullum tempus perdidit.

source: He hastily poured some Full Moon Essence Oil into his palm, utilizing his abilities to fuse it with his spirituality and rapidly dissipate it.
target: Festinanter effudit aliquantum olei essentiae Lunae plenae in palmam suam, utens facultatibus suis id cum spiritualitate sua coalescere atque celeriter dissipare.

source: Camus, Amandina, and the others immediately caught a refreshing, psychedelic fragrance.
target: Camus, Amandina, et ceteri statim perceperunt odorem refocillantem et inebriantem.

source: They felt their spirits were drunk, about to float out of their bodies.
target: Sentiebant spiritus eorum inebriatos esse, ut ex corporibus emergere imminent.

source: Robert’s voice echoed softly, distantly in their ears, causing their thoughts to drift farther and farther away.
target: Vox Roberti resonabat molliter, procul in auribus eorum, faciens ut cogitationes eorum longe ac longe evanescerent.

source: Fortunately, they weren’t channeling targets, so they managed relative control.
target: Fortunato, non destinabantur ut canales spirituum, ideo moderationem relative retinuerunt.

source: The black-robed figure gradually left the glass window, approaching Robert.
target: Figura nigro vestita gradatim fenestram vitream reliquit, ad Robertum accedens.

source: Suddenly, the shadow vanished.
target: Subito, umbra evanuit.

source: Robert lowered his head, then slowly looked up, his face tainted by the night sky yet with an obvious sinister aura.
target: Robertus caput inclinavit, deinde lente extulit oculos, facies eius caelo nocturno tincta, sed aura sinistra manifesta eminens.

source: His eyes were dark.
target: Oculi eius erant obscuri.

source: Observing this, Lumian ended the Summoning Dance, positioning himself three meters from Robert.
target: Observans hoc, Lumian saltationem evocatoria finivit, se tribus metris ab Roberto collocans.

source: Although he’d intended for Robert to channel the spirit directly while he provided questions, the peculiar shadow had instead attached itself to Robert.
target: Etsi propositum habebat Robertum spiritum directe canalis retinere, dum ipse quaestiones afferret, insolita umbra tamen ad Robertum se adligavit.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: This too was a form of spirit channeling—many Spirit Mediums allowed a target’s spirit to communicate through their mouth, answering certain people’s questions.
target: Hoc quoque erat forma canalizationis spiritus—multae media spirituum permittebant spiritum destinatario per os suum communicare, quaestiones quibusdam hominibus respondentibus.

source: Gazing at the sinister-looking Robert, Lumian pondered briefly, then said, “Do you know what happened to the people who lived here six years ago?”
target: Aspectans Robertum aspectu sinistro, Lumian brevi tempore meditatus est, deinde dixit: “Scisne quid acciderit hominibus qui hic ante sex annos vixerunt?”

source: He planned to start simple, least likely to cause anomalies, constantly adjusting direction, tone, and terminology based on the actual situation.
target: Consilium habebat simpliciter incipere, quod minime probabiliter anomalias excitaret, continuo directionem, tonum, et vocabula secundum rem actualem aptans.

source: Robert opened his mouth, letting out a shrill voice unlike his own.
target: Robertus os aperuit, efferens vocem stridulam, alienam ipsi.

source: “Affected, performed a ritual, all perished.”
target: Affecti, ritum exsecuti, omnes perierunt.

source: This answer puzzled the others, including Camus, unsure if significant information was hidden.
target: Hoc responsum ceteros perplexos reliquit, inter quos etiam Camus, incertos an notitia gravis occulta esset.

source: Apart from Lugano, everyone guessed Louis asked about the fire engulfing the Twanaku family, with the spirit’s answer implying a cult or evil gods’ influence.
target: Praeter Lugano, omnes putabant Louis quaesivisse de igne, qui familiam Twanaku devorabat, cum responsio spiritus insinuaretur cultui aut malis deis.

source: As a Conspirer, relevant information instantly surfaced in Lumian’s mind.
target: Ut Conspirator, notitiae pertinentes statim in mente Lumiani apparuerunt.

source: The suppressed emotions and desires of everyone in Tizamo would be absorbed by the dream, gradually accumulating to form corresponding dream projections.
target: Emotiones repressae et desideria omnium in Tizamo somnio absorbeerentur, paulatim accumulanda ut repraesentationes somniorum correspondentes formarentur.

source: Like the gravekeepers, these projections would hide in the dream’s chaotic zone, guarding the black ancient tomb.
target: Sicut custodes sepulchri, hae repraesentationes in zona caotica somnii latebunt, sepulcrum antiquum nigrum custodiantes.

source: In previous explorations, I saw the black-robed gravekeeper and projections surrounding the ancient tomb in dream fragments.
target: In explorationibus praeteritis, vidi custodem sepulchri in veste nigra et repraesentationes circum antiquum sepulcrum in fragmentis somniorum.

source: One projection was the remaining figure of “Hisoka” Twanaku.
target: Una repraesentatio fuit figura residua "Hisoka" Twanaku.

source: “Hisoka” Twanaku returned to Tizamo two or three times yearly for about a week.
target: "Hisoka" Twanaku ad Tizamo redibat bis vel ter in anno, per circiter hebdomadam.

source: After leaving, his corresponding projection would gradually fade until vanishing.
target: Postquam discessit, repraesentatio eius correspondens paulatim evanescere coepit, donec prorsus evanuit.

source: “Hisoka” Twanaku had become a Devil pathway Beyonder after the fire incident.
target: "Hisoka" Twanaku post incendium factus est Beyonder viae Diaboli.

source: The Nois family’s Demon…
target: Daemon familiae Nois…

source: This information appeared simultaneously in Lumian’s mind, like disconnected nodes in a spider’s web.
target: Haec notitia simul in mente Lumiani apparuit, instar nodorum disiunctorum in tela araneae.

source: Soon, Lumian made a guess.
target: Mox Lumian coniecturam fecit.

source: “Hisoka” Twanaku returned to Tizamo once or twice outside the Dream Festival, each visit lasting a week or more? Was this to ensure his dream projection didn’t completely disappear, allowing the dream to absorb some of his malice?
target: "Hisoka" Twanaku extra Festum Somniorum Tizamo redibat semel aut bis, quarum unaquaeque visita per hebdomadam aut diutius durabat? Num hoc factum est ut repraesentationem somnii eius non omnino evaniret, sinens somnium aliquod ex malitia eius absorbere?

source: Do the projections and gravekeepers stay around the ancient tomb because it has something special that unknowingly affects them, like the tomb or the cold corpse inside?
target: Num repraesentationes et custodes sepulchri circa sepulcrum antiquum manent, quia illud aliquid speciale habet quod eos incognite afficit, ut sepulcrum aut corpus frigidum intus?

source: If sacrificial rituals were part of the tomb’s defense, when the Dream Festival commences and the projections return to their bodies, would some deeply affected humans attempt to imitate the gravekeeper’s actions and perform a ritual?
target: Si ritus sacrificiales essent pars defensionis sepulchri, cum Festum Somniorum inciperet et repraesentationes ad corpora sua redirent, num aliqui homines valde affecti conari velint custodes imitari et ritum exsequi?

source: If they failed, would their entire family perish, corrupting the house and forming a subtle connection to the black ancient tomb?
target: Si deficerent, num tota familia periret, domum corrumpendo atque nexum subtiliter cum sepulcro antiquo nigro formans?

source: Yes, that’s a possibility, but I can’t fit the Nois family’s Demon or Hisoka becoming a Devil pathway Beyonder into this web of information…
target: Ita, hoc possibile est, sed Demon familiae Nois aut "Hisoka" Twanaku, factus Beyonder viae Diaboli, in hunc reticulum informationis inserere non possum.

source: What would happen if I inserted that?
target: Quid accideret, si id insererem?

source: Lumian’s heart stirred as he considered another possibility.
target: Cor Lumiani commotum est, cum alteram possibilitatem consideravit.

source: It wasn’t just the black ancient tomb or its cold corpse affecting the Twanaku family.
target: Non solum sepulcrum antiquum nigrum aut corpus eius frigidum familiae Twanaku afficiebant.

source: The Nois family’s Demon was also affected!
target: Daemon familiae Nois quoque afficiebatur!

source: Perhaps the Demon had been coveting the corpse or the source of abnormality.
target: Fortasse Daemon concupierat corpus aut fons abnormitatis.

source: For this reason, it secretly influenced the Twanaku family, giving them knowledge.
target: Propter hoc, occulte familiam Twanaku affecit, eis scientiam tradens.

source: Once the Dream Festival began, through its influence in the real world, it magnified their corresponding desires in the dream.
target: Cum Festum Somniorum inciperet, per suam influentiam in mundo reali, eorum desideria correspondenta in somnio augebat.

source: Coupled with the loss of self-control and wild indulgence brought by the Dream Festival, the Twanaku family took the initiative to attempt the sacrificial process from the ritual or dream projection given by the Demon, leading to subsequent abnormalities?
target: Coniuncto cum amissione sui temperamenti et ferocitate indulgentiae, quae Festum Somniorum attulit, familia Twanaku inceptum cepit tentandi processum sacrificii ex ritu aut repraesentatione somnii a Daemone traditam, quod ad posteriores anomalias duxit?

source: Had the Demon discovered Hisoka’s uniqueness and lured him to the Devil pathway?
target: Num Daemon singularitatem "Hisoka" detexit et eum ad viam Diaboli attraxit?

source: Yes, this explains why only the Twanaku family did such a thing when everyone has a dream projection and why is this house unique enough to allow lucid dreaming…
target: Ita, hoc explicat cur sola familia Twanaku tale fecerit, cum omnes repraesentationes somniorum haberent, et cur haec domus tam singularis sit ut somnia lucida sinat.

source: The next crucial task is guarding against the Demon.
target: Proximum negotium cruciale est contra Daemonem custodire.

source: It probably can’t participate personally, but its minions would definitely appear…
target: Probabiliter ipse personaliter non participabit, sed ministri eius certe apparebunt.

source: As these thoughts raced, Lumian gained a deeper understanding of the situation.
target: Dum hae cogitationes festinanter percurrebant, Lumian rem melius intellexit.

source: He looked at the shadow possessing Robert and changed his question.
target: Aspectavit umbram, quae Robertum possidebat, et quaestionem suam mutavit.

source: “Where are the gravekeepers? Where have they gone?”
target: Ubi sunt custodes sepulchri? Quo abierunt?

source: Robert’s shadowed face replied shrilly, “Dream Festival begins, the tomb opens. Need to hide.”
target: Facies umbrata Roberti respondit stridenter: "Festum Somniorum incipit, sepulcrum aperitur. Occultandum est."

source: Need to hide? After commencement, does the tomb become abnormally dangerous or pose a hidden danger to the gravekeepers?
target: Occultandum est? Post initium, num sepulcrum anomale periculosum fiat aut occultum periculum custodes sepulchri immineret?

source: Lumian glanced at Amandina. This lady, Robert, and Padre Cali arrived at the black ancient tomb during the Dream Festival, easily obtaining powers through contact.
target: Lumian Amandinae aspexit. Haec domina, Robertus, et Padre Cali ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum per Festum Somniorum pervenerunt, vires per contactum facile adepti.

source: Where is this hidden danger? How is it dangerous? And where are the gravekeepers?
target: Ubi est hoc periculum absconditum? Quomodo periculosum est? Et ubi sunt custodes sepulchri?

source: Something must be amiss.
target: Aliquid male est.

source: Amandina felt inexplicable fear under Louis Berry’s gaze.
target: Amandina inexplicabilem formidinem sub aspectu Ludovii Berry sensit.

source: Her voice trembled as she asked, “Is there a problem with this answer?”
target: Vox eius tremuit cum rogabat: "Estne quaestio in hoc responsu?"

source: Lumian chuckled. “The gravekeepers need to hide. Why didn’t you two?”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: "Custodes sepulchri se occultare debent. Cur vos duo non id fecistis?"

source: Before Amandina could delve deeper, she saw Robert’s cold, dark face contort in agony.
target: Antequam Amandina propius discere poterat, vidit faciem Roberti frigida et obscura, in dolore distortam.

source: Seeing this, Lumian sighed, “End the spirit channeling.”
target: Hoc videns, Lumian suspiravit: "Desine canalizationem spiritus."

source: If it continued, something would happen to Robert.
target: Si id continuaret, aliquid Roberti eveniret.

source: Robert retained complete autonomy and a certain mobility level.
target: Robertus plenam autonomiam et certum gradum mobilitatis retinuit.

source: He immediately uttered two words in ancient Hermes to make the spirit leave his body.
target: Statim duas verba in antiquo sermone Hermetico edixit, ut spiritus ex corpore suo exiret.

source: The shadow attached to him remained unresponsive, and the agony on his face intensified.
target: Umbra, quae ei adhaesit, nihil respondit, et dolor in facie eius intensus factus est.

source: Slowly, Robert drew a dagger and stabbed his finger.
target: Lente, Robertus pugionem extraxit et digitum suum confodit.

source: Drops of bright red blood, mixed with his Spirit Medium spirituality, sprayed towards the window like bead chains.
target: Guttae sanguinis rubri lucidi, cum spiritualitate medii spirituum eius mixta, in fenestram sparsae sunt, ut catenae perlarum.

source: While doing so, Robert bellowed in ancient Hermes, “Leave!”
target: Dum hoc faceret, Robertus in antiquo sermone Hermetico fremuit: "Discede!"

source: The black-robed shadow detached from Robert’s body, chasing after the blood and vanishing from the glass window.
target: Umbra in veste nigra a corpore Roberti se separavit, sanguinem insequens et ex fenestra vitrea evanescens.

source: Witnessing this, Lumian retracted his consciousness from his right hand, no longer preparing any “snorting.”
target: Hoc videns, Lumian suam conscientiam ex manu dextro retraxit, nec amplius ullum "sonitum sufflatorium" praeparabat.

source: He breathed a relieved sigh and said to Camus, Amandina, and the others, “Wait for me on the second floor.”
target: Suspiravit leviter et dixit ad Camum, Amandinam, et ceteros: "Exspectate me in secundo tabulato."

source: “What now…” Amandina muttered, turning to head downstairs.
target: "Quid nunc..." Amandina submurmuravit, conversans ut deorsum proficisceretur.

source: In just over ten seconds, silence returned to the third floor.
target: In paulo plus quam decem secundis, silentium in tertio tabulato rediit.

source: Lumian retrieved ingredients from his Traveler’s Bag and set up a ritual, attempting to summon Madam Magician’s messenger.
target: Lumian ex sacco viatoris sui ingredientes extraxit et ritum constituit, conans nuntium Dominae Magicae evocare.

source: Unfortunately, being a dream prevented success.
target: Infeliciter, somnium successum impedivit.

source: Having anticipated this, Lumian wasn’t overly disappointed.
target: Hoc praevidens, Lumian non nimis deiectus est.

source: Though the early Dream Festival arrival prevented reporting the latest situation to Madam Magician, adding significant risks, such problems were bound to arise.
target: Quamquam adventus Festi Somniorum praecoce relationem de novissima condicione Dominae Magicae prohibuit, additis periculis significantibus, talia problemata oriri debebant.

source: He was mentally prepared.
target: Mentibus praeparatus erat.

source: Though Hunters liked to plan ahead, they weren’t afraid of battle.
target: Quamquam Venatores praevidere libebant, bellum non timebant.

source: Lumian was even a little excited, not just from the Dream Festival’s faint influence.
target: Lumian etiam paulo excitatus erat, non solum ex tenuo influentia Festi Somniorum.

source: After stowing his belongings, Lumian descended to the second floor and said directly to Robert and Amandina, “Which one of you will take me to the black boulder?”
target: Postquam supellectilem suam recondidit, Lumian ad secundum tabulatum descendit atque directe ad Robertum et Amandinam dixit: "Quis ex vobis me ad saxum nigrum ducat?"

source: He had analyzed their situations, realizing that Amandina, Robert, and Padre Cali had easily arrived at the black ancient tomb and obtained powers, all led by those who had touched it.
target: Eum earum condiciones perspexerat, intellegens Amandinam, Robertum, et Padre Cali facile ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum perventos esse et vires adeptos habere, omnes ab iis qui illum tetigerant ductos.

source: Of course, they shared more than one thing in common.
target: Certe, plura in commune habebant.

source: Robert fell silent, wanting to say “Didn’t you promise to let me go after helping?” but not daring.
target: Robertus silentium cepit, cupiens dicere "Nonne pollebatis me dimittiturum post auxilium?" sed non ausus est.

source: Amandina glanced at the silent Robert, pursed her lips and said to Lumian, “Me!”
target: Amandina ad Robertum silentem aspexit, labra comprimit et Lumiani dixit: "Me!"

source: Then, she added, “I want to see if I can obtain more superpowers.”
target: Deinde addidit: "Volo videre, si plures potentias supernaturales adipisci possim."

source: Lumian nodded and told Robert, “You may leave.”
target: Lumian annuit et Roberto dixit: "Abi."

source: Robert glanced at Lumian, then Amandina.
target: Robertus in Lumianum deinceps aspexit, deinde in Amandinam.

source: Without a word, he walked out of Twanaku’s house.
target: Sine verbo, domum Twanaku reliquit.

source: “Gosh, he might think I brought you to the cathedral to deal with Padre Cali and embarrass him. Gosh, I was the one who brought you there,” Amandina exclaimed after Robert left.
target: "Eheu, putaret se existimare me vos ad cathedralem duxisse ut cum Padre Cali agerem et eum dedicerem. Eheu, ego fui qui vos iluc duxisse," exclamavit Amandina postquam Robert discessit.

source: Rhea, who had already picked up most arrows, earnestly consoled her, “But you purified the cathedral for God. Praise the Sun!”
target: Rhea, quae iam plerasque sagittas collegerat, eam sincere consolata est, dicens: "Sed tu cathedralam pro Deo purgasti. Laudate Solem!"

source: Amandina spread her arms as well. “Praise the Sun!”
target: Amandina quoque brachia extendit. "Laudate Solem!"

source: After their exchange, Lumian said to Camus and Rhea, “Next, I’m going to the black ancient tomb. It’s up to you to decide if you want to go.”
target: Post eorum sermonem, Lumian ad Camum et Rhea dixit: "Deinde ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum ibo; vobis est decernere, si ire velitis."

source: “I…” Lugano tried to speak, but Lumian interrupted with a smile. “You must go.”
target: "I..." Lugano conari verba edicere, sed Lumian subridens intermisit: "Tibi oportet ire."

source: Lugano shut his mouth.
target: Lugano os clausit.

source: Camus and Rhea exchanged glances and spoke in unison, “I’m coming too.”
target: Camus et Rhea oculis se invicem aspexerunt et simul dixerunt: "Ego quoque venio."

source: Lumian didn’t persuade them, simply nodding. “Then let’s set off now.”
target: Lumian eos non convincit, sed simpliciter annuens: "Ergo nunc eamus."
